entry.title: Dedicated side-by-side filament and printer comparisons
entry.summary: Each pair of material families or printers now has a permanent comparison page with its full specification table, dated source notes and links to both guides. Start with ASA vs PLA or Bambu A1 vs P1S, or browse the complete comparison library.
entry.content:

entry.title: Material-selection articles for real loads and service environments
entry.summary: Seven selection articles connect named FDM grades to published test conditions: load-bearing parts, structural composites, heat under load, moisture-conditioned nylon, outdoor components, creep and chemical exposure. The articles retain evidence gaps and verification steps beside the measured results.
